headline: Eleganz Interiors bags Rs 7.87 cr Aviation order
summary: Eleganz Interiors secures a Rs 7.87 crore design and build order from the Aviation industry. This adds to its Q2FY27 inflow of Rs 131.60 crore, bringing total disclosed orders to over Rs 139 crore.

headline: Tulsyan NEC uploads 79th AGM video recording
summary: Tulsyan NEC Limited has uploaded the video recording of its 79th Annual General Meeting, held on September 19, 2026, to its official website in compliance with SEBI regulations.

headline: Welspun Enterprises wins Rs 351.24 cr order from Ahmedabad Municipal Corp
summary: Welspun Enterprises wins Rs 351.24 crore work order from Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation for sewer line rehabilitation. Total disclosed order book stands at Rs 7,900 crore, representing 8.65 quarters of revenue coverage.

headline: Bagmane Prime Office REIT to speak at RICS India CRE Conference
summary: Bagmane Prime Office REIT management will participate in the RICS India CRE Conference on September 23, 2026. The session aims to provide insights into the commercial real estate market and the REIT's portfolio.

headline: Coforge expands AI vehicle lifecycle intelligence
summary: Coforge launches AI-powered vehicle lifecycle intelligence for lenders and fleet operators. The solution processes over 60,000 vehicles annually, creating trusted digital records to accelerate remarketing decisions.

headline: Sansera Engineering to host Goldman Sachs meeting
summary: Sansera Engineering Limited will host a group meeting with Goldman Sachs on September 24, 2026, in Bangalore. The interaction will cover publicly available information only.

headline: Maple Infra Trust discloses unitholding pattern
summary: Maple Infrastructure Trust filed its unitholding pattern as on September 11, 2026, with BSE. The disclosure follows the transfer of 37.50% units by the sponsor group to MAIF 4 Investments India 2 Pte. Ltd.

headline: JTL Industries to host investor meet on Sep 24
summary: JTL Industries management will attend the JM Financial Environmental & Energy Conclave in Mumbai on September 24, 2026. The session involves one-to-one and group interactions with analysts and institutional investors.

headline: Vedant Fashions to host virtual analyst meet on Sep 24
summary: Vedant Fashions Limited has scheduled a one-to-one virtual interaction with analysts and investors for September 24, 2026. The company clarified that no unpublished price-sensitive information will be discussed during the session.

headline: Jay Bharat Maruti accepts CS Shubha Singh resignation
summary: Jay Bharat Maruti Ltd accepted the resignation of Ms. Shubha Singh as Company Secretary effective September 19, 2026, citing personal reasons.

headline: Continental Securities promoter buys 24,500 shares
summary: Promoter Yash Khuteta acquired 24,500 Continental Securities Ltd shares on Sept 18, 2026, raising stake to 2.30% via open market purchase worth ₹5.95 lakh.
